national_news.title: Prime Minister Highlights Major Milestones in Counter-LWE Operations
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi celebrated Diwali with security personnel at the CRPF camp in Karanpur, Bastar (Chhattisgarh), highlighting national progress against Left Wing Extremism (LWE).
For the first time in 47 years, no CRPF jawan lost their life on duty in the past year, marking a shift from peak LWE influence across 230+ districts in 20 states.
Acknowledged the contributions of CRPF, CoBRA, BSF, ITBP, SSB, Bastar Fighters, and women commandos in eradicating Naxal violence and lifting 50 crore citizens out of extreme poverty.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Emphasizes Cyber Resilience and Agniveer Second Tour of Duty Policy
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addressed IAF personnel at Bagdogra Air Force Station, West Bengal, calling for high operational readiness against asymmetric warfare, cyberattacks, and drone swarms.
Highlighted the Cabinet's approval of the 'Second Tour of Duty' for Agniveers, making them eligible for regular soldier enrolment after completing their two-year engagement.
Stressed the role of 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat' in defense, encouraging integration of indigenous start-up technologies in cybersecurity, drones, and anti-drone systems.

national_news.title: Petroleum Ministry Confirms E20 Fuel Compliance with BIS Standard IS 17021
bullets: The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas confirmed that E20 petrol distributed by OMCs (IOCL, BPCL, HPCL) adheres to Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) specification IS 17021.
A total of 893 fuel samples tested across 27 States and Union Territories (including 56 in Karnataka) matched the mandated 19% to 20% ethanol blending range.
The statement countered claims of over-blending at retail outlets, establishing established quality assurance checks across OMC supply chains.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Highlights Evolving Security Threats and Indigenisation at Bagdogra
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addressed Air Force personnel at Bagdogra, emphasizing the strategic importance of the region in safeguarding North-Eastern India.
Highlighted the changing nature of modern warfare, noting that security threats now extend beyond conventional borders to include cyberattacks, drone warfare, proxy wars, and information warfare.
Stressed the vision of Aatmanirbhar Bharat, emphasizing the key role of Indian startups and domestic industries in manufacturing drones, anti-drone systems, and advanced defense tech.

national_news.title: PM Felicitates Asian Para Games Contingent; Highlights TOPS and Khelo India Ecosystem
bullets: India achieved a record-breaking tally of 114 medals (30 gold, 35 silver, 49 bronze) along with 5 world records and 9 Asian records at the Asian Para Games.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted the role of grassroot programs, Khelo India Centres, and the Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS) in building a modern sports ecosystem aimed at Los Angeles 2028 Olympics.
Women athletes showcased exceptional performance with 34 out of 56 female participants securing medals, alongside strong debut performances where 36 out of 61 first-time competitors won medals.

national_news.title: Government Integrates Startup India and I-STEM Portals to Boost R&D Access
bullets: The Office of the Principal Scientific Adviser (PSA), led by Prof. Ajay Kumar Sood, launched an API integration between the 'Startup India' portal and the 'I-STEM' (Indian Science, Technology and Engineering Facilities Map) portal.
The initiative, undertaken with DPIIT (Ministry of Commerce and Industry), allows DPIIT-recognised startups to seamlessly discover and access national scientific research and testing facilities.
The synergy aims to significantly lower research and development (R&D) costs, prevent duplication of costly equipment, and ensure optimal utilization of publicly funded scientific infrastructure.

national_news.title: IAF Partners with IIT Madras to Develop Indigenous Airborne Communication System
bullets: The Indian Air Force's (IAF) Software Development Institute signed a Memorandum of Agreement (MoA) with IIT Madras and IITM Pravartak Technologies Foundation.
The collaboration will focus on designing and developing an indigenous, secure digital communication system tailored for airborne applications and networked warfare operational environments.
Key development areas include advanced encryption protocols, resilient data transmission, and seamless integration with existing defence networks to promote self-reliance under Atmanirbhar Bharat.

national_news.title: Government Approves 2-Year Extension and Permanent Absorption Option for Agniveers
bullets: Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh announced that Agniveers will be granted an additional two-year extension beyond their initial four-year tenure, enabling eligibility for permanent regular enrolment.
Upon completion of the full six-year service period, all serving Agniveers meeting physical fitness, discipline, and selection criteria will be eligible for regular service absorption.
Launched in June 2022 for candidates aged 17.5 to 21 years, the original Agnipath scheme mandated a four-year engagement period with a provision to retain only 25% of recruits in regular service.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Launch Drive for Voluntary Surrender of Electricity Subsidy
bullets: The Bihar state government announced a campaign starting December 1, 2026, to encourage affluent families to voluntarily give up their electricity subsidy.
Under the state's free power initiative, 1.92 crore families currently receive 125 units of free electricity.
The state government provides an estimated subsidy worth approximately Rs 10,000 annually per family.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Announces 83-km Ganga Riverfront Road Connecting Munger and Bhagalpur
bullets: The Bihar government has announced the construction of an 83-km Ganga riverfront road connecting Munger and Bhagalpur to boost regional transport and economic development along the river corridor.
The announcement was made during the Munger Deepotsav at Kalyanpur in Bariarpur block, Munger district, where over 11.11 lakh (11,11,111) lamps were lit.
The project aims to improve transport connectivity, manage seasonal flooding challenges along the Ganga river basin, and support the state's broader initiative to curb out-migration by 2030.
